item.title: Xbox Indie Program Lead Advises Devs Interested in Project Helix to Start Working on Xbox for PC Versions Now
item.description: Chris Charla, the general manager of portfolio and programs at Xbox, has been with Xbox for 16 years, and worked on ID@Xbox for 13. At this year's GDC, I was able to formally interview him about his job, the indie landscape, and what's on the horizon for Xbox and its third party relationships.

item.title: These New Asus Open Wireless Earbuds Are Perfect for a Specific Type of Gamer
item.description: Where other gaming earbuds rely on software to let in ambient noise, the Asus ROG Cetra open wireless earbuds sit outside your ear canals letting you hear your surroundings at all times. For some people – parents of young kids, for example – that's a godsend, and it's backed up by impressive battery life and a comfortable fit.
